body: Cintula, Petr, Fermüller, Christian G., Noguera, Carles, in the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entry "Fuzzy Logic" says: "Fuzzy logic is intended to model logical reasoning with vague or imprecise statements like “Petr is young (rich, tall, hungry, etc.)”. It refers to a family of many-valued logics , where the truth-values are interpreted as degrees of truth. The truth-value of a logically compound proposition, like “Carles is tall and Chris is rich”, is determined by the truth-value of its components. In other words, like in classical logic, one imposes truth-functionality." This card reports that entry's preamble. It does not treat the entry as the original paper it cites.
